name: RTX PRO 5000 Blackwell vLLM: meta-llama/Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct median TTFT, 1000 requests
unit: ms (median time to first token, 1000 concurrent)
methodology: Database Mart vLLM bench on one RTX PRO 5000 Blackwell 48 GB GDDR7 ECC (Server Edition, not the 72 GB workstation SKU). Model meta-llama/Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct, quantization column '16' (bf16/fp16 not distinguished; format_id null, no fp16 record exists). vLLM commit not printed. Single GPU, tensor parallel 1. 1000 requests, input length 100 tokens, output length 600 tokens, benchmark duration 174.59 s, total input tokens 100000, total generated tokens 502596. AGGREGATE across the concurrent requests, not a per-request decode rate.
notes: Median TTFT under the same 1000-request run. P99 TTFT is higher and is not recorded.
